# Quill Payments

Quill Payments is the card processor behind Beacon invoices. Fees are 2.4% plus
30 cents; chargeback disputes are answered inside the Quill dashboard within
seven days or the merchant loses by default.

Related: [[Pricing Ladder]], [[Data Export API]].
